original_card.question: Does a changed construction's serialized target/paid invoice independently support its claimed improvement?
methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.
Seek an exact counterexample or target-specific complete-budget obstruction to that same proposed change.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read revision 8, the selected review and live exact-source handoffs. Then follow this card's bounded first_experiment.
first_step.scope: Source-bound orientation only, not a supplier replay or theorem proof.

original_card.first_experiment: Independently recount one changed emitted word and its complete caller, importing no constructor or pricing engine. Include target losses, owned lifetimes, native orientation and extra charges. Check existing #5633/#5708/#5717/#5719 coverage to avoid duplicate audits and preserve its exact head. Stop after the chosen missing implication; a correct root alone is not supplier admission.

actual_scope: Independent recount, at the exact open PR #7630 head 6026e87d1cac03eb5bd2aa8524a8f5891dd9934e, of (1) the header and initial-chart change from the #7623 word, (2) the chart chronology of both complete words, (3) the MOVE rank histogram of both words and its relation to the declared 17-call paid invoice, (4) the helper target ranks of both words and their relation to the declared target invoice, and (5) the signs of the declared complete moment at the claim, at the point above it, and at the #7623 and #7627 values. No constructor, application or pricing engine of the PR is imported.
scope_change_reason: The first experiment of the card is applied to a newer exact head. No audit of #7630 or of its parent #7623 was found among the open PRs on 2026-11-17. #7630 differs from the #7612 recount in two ways. It changes seven stops and re-settles the hub ADD and SCALE events jointly, so the word grows from 77,277 to 208,738 events. It also changes the productive target histogram, so this audit recounts the helper targets as well.
bottleneck_link: The complex supplier binds. #7630 changes paid MOVE ranks and helper target ranks of the P104 word. Its generic replay builds the candidate invoice as the #7623 invoice plus a declared per-call delta. This audit binds both sides of that delta to the emitted word bytes.
stop_rule: Stop after the word-to-invoice binding and the moment signs are resolved or one exact mismatch is found. Do not replay the native, signed, physical, ordinary or outer stages.
evidence: verify.py passes on CPython 3.13.9 (Windows) in about 2 s: paid = 17 x (MOVE rank histogram of the word) + one fixed caller histogram, equal for #7623 and #7630 and equal to the one of the #7612 recount; targets = 17 x (helper target rank histogram) + one fixed caller target histogram; the native delta {1:-2,2:-3,3:-5,5:+1,6:+2} and the helper delta {6:+2,9:-2} are recounted from the words; both words have a legal chart chronology; seven moment signs agree with the PR; the change is no worse for every tent tariff min(r,a); and ten controls reject.
